method: SQL中转换表后14行窗口检索，未执行映射表查询，不包含映射行全集；同一任务可有多处相同配置

join_lines: ON CAST(UPPER(A.TRADE_DIRECTION) AS STRING)  = B.SRC_CD_VAL    --TRADE_DIRECTION 转码
AND SRC_SYS_NAME='OIS') C ON        A.INDUSTRY = C.SRC_CD_VAL
AND SRC_SYS_NAME='OIS') C ON        A.INDUSTRY = C.SRC_CD_VAL
AND SRC_SYS_NAME = 'OIS') dict1 on dict1.SRC_CD_VAL = A.industry
and remark = 'OTC_DERIVATIVE_COUNTERPARTY.PROD_TYPE') dict2 on dict2.dw_cd_val = A.prod_type
left join dict dict3 on dict3.dict_category = 'xz' and dict3.source = A.source and dict3.dict_value = A.nature
left join dict dict4 on dict4.dict_category = 'nation' and  dict4.source = A.source and dict4.dict_value = A.register_country
left join review_buffer B on B.client_id = A.client_id
